subject: CONFIRMED SOURCE ISSUE: privilege-session loss can bypass cover readiness/recovery
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=reviewer-shizuku-recovery-gen2-20261001. Reconstructed current main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. Confirmed source issue A: Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.visualMirrorActive depends only on mirrorRequested + controller COVER_VISUAL. onPrivilegedUnavailable clears mirror/session/prewarm bookkeeping and invalidates coverReadiness, but does not demote controller state or clear mirrorRequested. Confirmed source issue B: Fold7ContinuityController COVER_READY_HIDDEN transitions to COVER_VISUAL at <=135deg without consulting coverReadiness. Therefore loss/reconnect can leave controller logically READY_HIDDEN after readiness was invalidated, and a later hinge sample can emit ShowMirror without fresh route proof. Confirmed source issue C: DuoShellService SHIZUKU_DESTROY stops live mirror and exits, but does not drain/reconcile Fold7CoverPanelLease before coverMutationExecutor shutdown. Fold7CoverPanelLease is in-memory only; a new DuoShellService starts with IDLE. Existing onPrivilegedDaemonRestart(topology) recovery logic exists in the model but is not wired into the inspected startup/reconcile path. Platform check: Shizuku documents that daemon-mode UserService persists until unbind; destroy transaction is explicitly where cleanup should occur, and Shizuku stop/restart kills the UserService. Adversarial isolated model: 9/9 PASS reproducing four CURRENT failure invariants and five Gen2 recovery invariants. Proposed direction: make privilege epoch/recovery a first-class gate; on privilege loss revoke visual authority and invalidate the active privileged cycle; on reconnect run shell recovery before any new prewarm/visual; graceful SHIZUKU_DESTROY drains the cover lease using framework logical reset only; cold-start enters UNKNOWN_RECOVERY and blocks new prewarm until native-cover or a freshly validated non-default cover route normalizes ownership. No raw physical OFF. No production GitHub writes.
